scope: Read-only review of guards addressing CodeQL292 and296; compiler293-295 are owned and reviewed separately. Only this report written.

evidence: The parsed URL is checked directly for exact api.telegram.org/api.vk.com hostname, HTTPS, no userinfo, query or fragment; custom nondefault port rejected. The same validated URL object is passed to fetch.

VK accepts exactly /method/<one allowlisted read method>. Telegram accepts exactly /bot<bounded credential alphabet>/<getMe|getChat|getChatMember>. Post/upload endpoints, extra path segments and encoded path delimiters fail before fetch.

Credential strings are bounded and delimiter-restricted before interpolation. Provider exception text is replaced by a code; output remains selected identities, booleans and numeric diagnostics. No token or provider error_msg is serialized.
Redirect mode is forced to error and the20second deadline replaces caller overrides. Tests confirm invalid targets make zero mocked requests.

The trusted https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: namespace is a literal. Only the complete dynamic P18 filename is passed to encodeURIComponent, with no subsequent decode or replacement of encoded delimiters.

Regression exercises repeated colons, percent, space, slash, Cyrillic, query and fragment delimiters. The resulting URL has empty search/hash and one decode returns the original filename. The identical evidence URL is used by destination permissions.

Commons exact-title matching, fixed upload host, supported-license check, MIME/hash verification and bounded raster normalization remain in place. This URI is license evidence, not an arbitrary credentialed fetch target.

tests.providerResponses: injected fixtures; synthetic raster bytes only

limits: No CodeQL rescan, alert dismissal or assertion that remote alerts are already closed; exact new-head CI remains the release proof.
No live credentials read or printed; no real provider requests, uploads, posts or production DB writes.
This bounded review does not replace the separate compiler293-295 review or full remote required checks.
